intent: Technical Brief: Dell Alienware M15 R6 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Excessive heat causing thermal throttling and shutdowns
suggested_solution: Check BIOS settings for TC (or TCC) offset in the power or performance section to reduce thermal throttling.
Consider contacting Dell Support to inquire about repair options outside of warranty, as parts may be unavailable.
Explore alternative solutions, such as using a desktop computer or purchasing a new Alienware laptop.
